channel.title: rage Vault: Roskilde '96
channel.desc: This week on the VAULT, we're taking you back to 1996 Danish music festival Roskilde. The four day festival attracted 115,000 punters and was headlined by Bjork, David Bowie, Patti Smith and Nick Cave.
